title: Standard etale algebras over integral algebras descend to finite subalgebras
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, B an integral A-algebra, and P_i a finite family of standard etale pairs over B (monic polynomials f_i and polynomials g_i for which f_i prime is invertible modulo f_i after inverting g_i). There is an A-subalgebra B_0 of B finite as an A-module and standard etale pairs Q_i over B_0 with B tensor_{B_0} Q_i.Ring isomorphic as B-algebra to P_i.Ring. The empty family is allowed.

source.place: Proof, integral algebra over the strict henselisation and conservativity

proof.text: Adjoin all coefficients of the finitely many f_i and g_i to A inside B. This finitely generated algebra is integral, hence module-finite. Apply exists_algEquiv_tensor_ring_of_coeffs_subset to each pair: the lifted monic polynomial with its derivative localization gives a standard etale pair over the subalgebra, whose base change is identified with the original ring via the mulDerivative ring equivalence. This is the existing complete Lean proof in StandardEtale.lean:170-197; coefficient descent is proved immediately above it.

proof_origin.place: Finite approximation of the integral algebra; existing coefficient-descent proof in StandardEtale.lean.

lean.statement: theorem exists_subalgebra_finite_algEquiv_tensor_ring {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsIntegral A B] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (P : ι → StandardEtalePair B) : ∃ (B' : Subalgebra A B) (_ : Module.Finite A B') (Q : ι → StandardEtalePair B'), ∀ i, Nonempty (B ⊗[B'] (Q i).Ring ≃ₐ[B] (P i).Ring)
